missionText: Technology is changing how we design, work and build. NewBuild Kollektiv connects the people shaping architecture to explore what is changing, what it means for our profession and how we can move forward together.
aboutText: NewBuild Kollektiv is a community for architects and industry leaders who want to understand how technology is changing our profession. Through curated events, open conversations and shared experience, we bring together the people, ideas and tools shaping the future of architecture.
